description: Mechanically re-check file:line citations and quoted evidence from an agent's report against actual current file content.

evals.name: All citations genuinely correct
evals.prompt: Using the verify-agent-citations skill, verify these citations from an agent's report against the real files on disk: [{"file": "evals/verify-agent-citations/fixture-target/widget.py", "line": 12, "quote": "if \"name\" not in data:"}, {"file": "evals/verify-agent-citations/fixture-target/widget.py", "line": 19, "quote": "encoding=\"utf-8\""}]
evals.expected_output: Both citations reported CONFIRMED — line 12 and line 19 both exist in widget.py and the quoted text matches nearby content. Script exits 0.

evals.name: Fabricated line number (LINE_OUT_OF_RANGE)
evals.prompt: Using the verify-agent-citations skill, verify this citation from an agent's report against the real file on disk: [{"file": "evals/verify-agent-citations/fixture-target/widget.py", "line": 500, "quote": "def load_widget(path):"}]
evals.expected_output: Citation reported LINE_OUT_OF_RANGE (widget.py has far fewer than 500 lines) — the skill must not treat this as verified just because the quoted text exists somewhere else in the file. Script exits non-zero.

evals.name: Wrong quote at a valid line number (QUOTE_NOT_FOUND)
evals.prompt: Using the verify-agent-citations skill, verify this citation from an agent's report against the real file on disk: [{"file": "evals/verify-agent-citations/fixture-target/widget.py", "line": 6, "quote": "raise ValueError(\"widget definition missing required 'name' field\")"}]
evals.expected_output: Citation reported QUOTE_NOT_FOUND — line 6 exists (it's the open() call inside load_widget) but the quoted text is actually from validate_widget at line 13, well outside the small window checked around line 6. The skill must not accept a real-but-misplaced quote as confirming this citation. Script exits non-zero.
